parameters.content:
## Data Ingestion P2.3 — XML registry sync + stable Qdrant

The XML feed is grouped by parent `item_group_id`. Only shard index 0 writes Google Sheets, using one `values:batchUpdate` request to avoid quota/race conditions.

Protected columns: `MA_SP`, `SHOP_ALIAS`, `BRAND`, `ACTIVE`, `MATERIAL_OVERRIDE`, `DESCRIPTION_OVERRIDE`, `COLOR_OVERRIDE`, `STYLE_OVERRIDE`, `MATERIAL_COMPONENTS_OVERRIDE`.

Structured extraction v2 preserves Vietnamese accents. Colors are read only from color contexts; materials are mapped by component; styles are evidence-scored and limited to two labels. Auto-derived fields are recalculated instead of merged with prior auto values.

Overrides: `COLOR_OVERRIDE` and `STYLE_OVERRIDE` use `|`. `MATERIAL_COMPONENTS_OVERRIDE` uses `ÁO: ...; QUẦN: ...; CHÂN VÁY: ...; PHỤ KIỆN: ...; LÓT: ...`.

Auto-managed columns: `XML_GROUP_ID`, blank `RULE_TYPE/CATEGORY`, aliases, K:Y XML/search metadata, plus AC:AH (`COLOR_PRIMARY`, `COLOR_DETAIL`, `MATERIAL_COMPONENTS_JSON`, `STYLE_PRIMARY`, `STYLE_SECONDARY`, `EXTRACTION_WARNINGS`).

Qdrant keeps stable search data only. Price, stock, promotion, live size availability, fulfillment and ETA remain in POS/Sheets/Redis.

Required env: `DATA_INGESTION_V2_SHEET_ID`, `QDRANT_API_KEY`, `REDIS_URL`. Optional: `INGEST_SHARD_COUNT`, `INGEST_SHARD_INDEX`, `LANA_PRODUCT_FEED_URL`, `QDRANT_BASE_URL`, `QDRANT_COLLECTION_INGEST_V2`, `CATALOG_BUILD_VERSION`.

## INGEST_LOG header

Paste into A1:

`RUN_ID	STARTED_AT	FINISHED_AT	TOTAL	SUCCESS	SKIPPED	DELETED	FAILED	ERROR_SAMPLE`

Successful execution data is not retained by n8n; the summary is written here to avoid SQLite growth.

## Stable point identity + orphan cleanup

Point ID: `brand | MA_SP | normalized_image_url`. Size and image role are not included because the feed repeats identical images across S/M/L/XL and may reorder items.

After ingestion, the workflow scrolls Qdrant points owned by `P2.3_XML_REGISTRY` and deletes IDs absent from the current active XML/registry manifest. Cleanup is shard-aware, blocks an empty manifest, caps delete count/ratio and supports dry-run.

Optional env: `ORPHAN_CLEANUP_ENABLED`, `ORPHAN_CLEANUP_DRY_RUN`, `ORPHAN_DELETE_MAX`, `ORPHAN_DELETE_MAX_RATIO`, `ORPHAN_SCROLL_PAGE_SIZE`, `ORPHAN_SCROLL_MAX_PAGES`. Price/stock changes never trigger Vertex embedding.
